releaseName: Answer the career interview by voice
summary: One sprint since the guided career interview (milestone 72). Candidates can answer the career interview by voice: Whisper base runs in the browser, so audio never leaves the device (#2200, #2201). The server serves the pinned model files from its own origin and refuses any file whose bytes differ from the pin (#2199). The record archive now holds career interview sessions (#2202). The interviewer varies how its turns open (career-interview-v2), and a capped walk confirmed a summary into transcript evidence (#2203).
knownLimitations: Voice input runs on WebAssembly only, so an answer takes a few seconds to transcribe on a laptop, and the first use downloads about 80 MB of model files. French and English are the tested languages. The interview still needs content screening in rules+model mode and recorded consent to send career material to Anthropic, and the web shows it in owner-token mode only. No draft run has yet been shown citing a confirmed summary.
